info.title: Fundan public API
info.description: Open funding opportunities for Kyrgyzstan and Central Asia (grants, loans, investors, accelerators, fellowships). Read-only, no authentication for the endpoints below. Data is in Russian; add lang=en for English card fields. Always point users to the funder's official page.

get.description: Up to 6 opportunities: nearest deadlines (within 7 days) first, then verified rolling intake. totalOpen is the number of currently open entries.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: adds an 'en' object with English card fields

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: free-form description of the need, Russian or English

200.description: JSON with total, visibleTotal, results[] (limited without an access code)
